requirements.requirement: A 2019 article was published in November 2019 by a media company founded in the 1960s and discusses different scoring methods for various types of the same sport.
The 2019 article references only one professional athlete by name throughout the entire article.
In January 2020, a media company that originated in the 1950s published a 2020 article about the professional athlete referenced by name in the 2019 article.
The 2020 article contains excerpts from an interview that the athlete had done.
The 2020 article states the hometown of the athlete.
